## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the affected component
or upstream source when useful. Explain intentional departures from Arc.

## Validation

Record the commands and browser cases run, including reduced motion and keyboard
behavior for UI changes. Include screenshots or recordings when they help review.
State any checks or variants that remain unverified. Update ROADMAP.md and the
relevant verification notes; record intentional differences in docs/PORTING.md.

## Attribution

For newly adapted source or assets, identify their source and license and retain
the required copyright and permission notices.
